definitions.explanation: The very highest or most excellent degree of something. Used to describe something that has reached the pinnacle of quality, status, or importance.

examples.japanese: {至高|しこう}の{喜|よろこ}びを{感|かん}じた。
これは{至高|しこう}の{一品|いっぴん}と{言|い}えるだろう。
examples.english: This could be called the ultimate dish.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}にとって{音楽|おんがく}は{至高|しこう}の{芸術|げいじゅつ}であり、{人生|じんせい}そのものだった。
examples.english: For him, music was the supreme art form and life itself.

notes:
Composed of {至|し} (to reach the utmost) and {高|こう} (high). The word conveys a sense of the absolute highest level.

Often used in literary, formal, or emphatic contexts. In everyday speech, {最高|さいこう} is more common for expressing "the best" or "supreme."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至高|しこう}の{存在|そんざい} (supreme being)
- {至高|しこう}の{喜|よろこ}び (supreme joy)
- {至高|しこう}の{一品|いっぴん} (ultimate dish, finest item)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {至高|しこう}: supreme, the very highest (literary, elevated)
- {最高|さいこう}: the best, highest (everyday usage)
- {究極|きゅうきょく}: ultimate, final (emphasis on reaching the end point)
